references.text: The Lord repeats the warning not to go up and fight, because He is not with them
Israel could not stand against their enemies because the Lord was not with them due to sin
Samson did not know that the Lord had left him, and he was overcome by the Philistines
The glory of the Lord departed from Israel when the ark of the covenant was captured by the Philistines
David understood that the Lord must be with him to defeat his enemies
The prophet Azariah warned that the Lord is with you when you are with Him, but if you forsake Him, He will forsake you
Warning that they will fall before their enemies when the Lord turns against them
The curse upon Israel: they will be struck down before their enemies when they forsake the Lord
